CreativeWork: Any work of human creativity: a book, article, film, image, song, or software. Also called work, content, publication.
Article: A written composition published in a newspaper, magazine, or website. Also called piece, story, write-up.
NewsArticle: A news report on a current event. Also called news story, report, dispatch.
ReportageNewsArticle: A factual news report based on journalistic reporting. Also called news report, straight news.
AnalysisNewsArticle: A news article offering interpretation and analysis of events. Also called analysis piece, news analysis.
OpinionNewsArticle: A news article expressing opinion rather than reporting. Also called op-ed, opinion piece, column.
ReviewNewsArticle: A news article reviewing a product, work, or performance. Also called review article.
AdvertiserContentArticle: A paid article placed or produced for an advertiser. Also called advertorial, sponsored content, native advertising.
SatiricalArticle: An article that is primarily satirical and not literally true. Also called satire, spoof.
TechArticle: A technical article such as a how-to or specification. Also called technical document, guide.
APIReference: Reference documentation for an API. Also called API docs, API documentation.
ScholarlyArticle: A scholarly research article. Also called academic paper, research paper, journal article.
MedicalScholarlyArticle: A scholarly article in medicine. Also called medical paper, medical research article.
Thesis: A document submitted for an academic degree. Also called dissertation, doctoral thesis.
Book: A written or printed work of substantial length. Also called volume, title, publication. Examples: a novel, a textbook.
Audiobook: A recorded spoken version of a book. Also called talking book, spoken-word book.
BookSeries: A set of related books. Also called book collection, series.
Chapter: A numbered or named division of a book. Also called section.
Manuscript: A handwritten document or work. Also called handwritten document, codex.
Periodical: A publication issued at regular intervals. Also called magazine, journal, serial. Examples: a monthly magazine.
PublicationVolume: A numbered volume of a periodical or multi-volume work. Also called volume.
Play: A dramatic work of dialogue written for theatrical performance. Also called drama, stage play, script.
Quotation: A passage quoted from a work or person. Also called quote, citation, excerpt.
Statement: A statement asserting something, such as an interesting fact. Also called assertion, declaration.
Claim: A factual claim that can be fact-checked. Also called assertion, allegation.
ClaimReview: A fact-checking review of a claim. Also called fact-check.
MediaReview: A review evaluating online media for accuracy or manipulation. Also called media fact-check.
MediaReviewItem: An item or group of media items evaluated in a media review. Also called reviewed media.
Review: An evaluation of an item such as a restaurant, film, or product. Also called critique, assessment, write-up.
CriticReview: A professional review by a recognised critic. Also called professional review, critic's review.
UserReview: A review written by an end-user. Also called customer review, user rating.
EmployerReview: A review of an organisation as an employer by a current or former employee. Also called workplace review.
Recommendation: A review suggesting something as the best option. Also called endorsement, suggestion, pick.
Guide: A page or article recommending products, services, or options to consider. Also called buying guide, how-to guide.
Comment: A remark posted in response to content, such as a blog post. Also called reply, remark, response.
CorrectionComment: A comment correcting a creative work. Also called correction, erratum.
Answer: A response offered to a question. Also called reply, response, solution.
Question: A question seeking an answer. Also called query, enquiry.
Quiz: A test of knowledge or skills. Also called test, knowledge check.
Blog: A regularly updated website of posts in reverse chronological order. Also called weblog.
BlogPosting: A single post on a blog. Also called blog post, blog entry.
LiveBlogPosting: A blog post giving rolling live coverage of an event. Also called live blog, live updates.
DiscussionForumPosting: A post in a discussion forum. Also called forum post, thread post.
SocialMediaPosting: A post on a social media platform. Also called social post, tweet, status update.
Message: A single message sent from a sender to recipients. Also called note, communication.
EmailMessage: An email message. Also called email, e-mail.
Course: A structured educational course of study. Also called class, programme, module.
Syllabus: A document describing the material covered in a course. Also called course outline, curriculum.
LearningResource: A creative work oriented toward learning or education. Also called educational resource, teaching material.
ExercisePlan: A planned fitness activity for a health goal. Also called workout plan, training programme.
Diet: A regulated plan of food intake for a health goal. Also called eating plan, dietary regimen.
Recipe: Instructions for preparing a dish. Also called cooking instructions, formula.
HowTo: Instructions to achieve a result through a sequence of steps. Also called how-to guide, tutorial, instructions.
HowToStep: A single step in a how-to. Also called instruction step.
HowToSection: A grouping of steps within a how-to. Also called step section.
HowToDirection: A single action within how-to instructions. Also called direction, instruction.
HowToTip: A supplementary tip within how-to instructions. Also called tip, hint.
Menu: A list of food and drink items offered by an eatery. Also called bill of fare, menu card.
MenuSection: A grouping of items within a menu, such as a course. Also called menu category.
Movie: A motion picture or film. Also called film, motion picture, feature.
MovieClip: A short segment of a movie. Also called film clip, excerpt.
MovieSeries: A series of related movies. Also called film series, franchise.
TVSeries: A television series. Also called TV show, series, programme.
TVSeason: A single season of a TV series. Also called series season.
TVEpisode: A single episode of a TV series. Also called episode, instalment.
TVClip: A short segment of a TV programme. Also called TV clip.
RadioSeries: A radio series. Also called radio show, radio programme.
RadioSeason: A single season of a radio series. Also called radio season.
RadioEpisode: A single episode of a radio series. Also called radio episode.
RadioClip: A short segment of a radio programme. Also called radio clip.
PodcastSeries: An episodic series of downloadable audio or video. Also called podcast, podcast show.
PodcastSeason: A single season of a podcast. Also called podcast season.
PodcastEpisode: A single episode of a podcast. Also called podcast episode.
Episode: A single episode of a series. Also called instalment, part.
Season: A single season of a media series. Also called series, run.
Clip: A short segment of a longer programme. Also called excerpt, segment.
CreativeWorkSeason: A season of a media series. Also called series season.
CreativeWorkSeries: A group of related published works in sequence. Also called series.
Game: A rule-governed recreational activity. Also called pastime, contest.
VideoGame: An electronic game played via a user interface. Also called computer game, console game.
VideoGameSeries: A series of related video games. Also called game franchise.
VideoGameClip: A short segment of a video game. Also called game clip.
MusicAlbum: A collection of music tracks released together. Also called album, LP, record.
MusicRecording: A recording of a single song or track. Also called track, song, recording.
MusicComposition: A musical composition or piece. Also called song, piece, work.
MusicRelease: A specific release of a music album. Also called album release, edition.
MusicPlaylist: An ordered collection of music tracks. Also called playlist, mixtape.
MusicVideoObject: A music video file. Also called music video.
SheetMusic: Printed musical notation. Also called score, music sheet.
VisualArtwork: A work of art that is primarily visual. Also called artwork, art piece.
Painting: A picture made with paint. Also called canvas, artwork. Examples: the Mona Lisa.
Drawing: A picture made with pen, pencil, or crayon. Also called sketch, illustration.
Sculpture: A three-dimensional work of art. Also called statue, carving.
Photograph: A photographic image. Also called photo, picture, snapshot.
Poster: A large printed placard for advertising or display. Also called bill, placard.
CoverArt: Artwork on the cover of a work. Also called cover, jacket art.
ComicCoverArt: The cover artwork of a comic. Also called comic cover.
SequentialArt: Art using ordered images for storytelling, such as comics or manga. Also called comics, graphic narrative.
ComicSeries: A series of comic stories under one title. Also called comic, comic book series.
ComicIssue: A single issue of a comic series. Also called comic book, issue.
ComicStory: An indivisible unit of a comic, such as an interior story or cover. Also called comic strip, comic story.
Map: A diagrammatic representation of an area. Also called chart, plan.
Barcode: An image of a machine-readable code. Also called QR code, scan code.
Certification: An official statement attesting characteristics of a subject. Also called certificate, accreditation. Examples: ISO certification, Organic certification.
Credential: A certificate verifying the identity or qualifications of a person or entity. Also called qualification, credential.
EducationalOccupationalCredential: A diploma, degree, certification, or badge awarded for meeting requirements. Also called qualification, degree, diploma.
Legislation: A legal document such as an act, decree, or bill. Also called law, statute, act, bill.
LegislationObject: A specific file or object containing legislation. Also called legal text file.
SpecialAnnouncement: A dated information update from a local organisation, often crisis-related. Also called announcement, notice, advisory.
Dataset: A published collection of structured data. Also called data collection, data set, corpus.
DataCatalog: A catalogue of datasets. Also called data directory.
DataFeed: A feed providing structured data about entities or topics. Also called data stream, feed.
CompleteDataFeed: A data feed containing every current item. Also called full feed.
DataDownload: A downloadable form of a dataset. Also called data file, download.
Code: Computer programming source code. Also called source code, script, snippet.
SoftwareSourceCode: Computer programming source code. Also called source code, script, codebase.
SoftwareApplication: A software program. Also called app, application, program, software.
MobileApplication: An app designed for mobile devices. Also called mobile app, app.
WebApplication: A software application that runs in a web browser. Also called web app.
OperatingSystem: System software managing a computer's hardware and resources. Also called OS. Examples: Windows, Linux, macOS.
RuntimePlatform: A software environment for executing programs. Also called runtime, platform.
MediaObject: A media file such as an image, video, audio, or document. Also called media file, asset.
ImageObject: An image file. Also called image, picture, photo.
ImageObjectSnapshot: An exact byte-for-byte version of an image file. Also called image snapshot.
AudioObject: An audio file. Also called audio, sound file, recording.
AudioObjectSnapshot: An exact byte-for-byte version of an audio file. Also called audio snapshot.
VideoObject: A video file. Also called video, clip, footage.
VideoObjectSnapshot: An exact byte-for-byte version of a video file. Also called video snapshot.
3DModel: A 3D content model. Also called 3D model, 3D asset, mesh.
TextObject: A text file, plain or marked up. Also called text file, document.
NoteDigitalDocument: A digital note file, mainly for the author. Also called note, memo.
SpreadsheetDigitalDocument: A spreadsheet file. Also called spreadsheet, workbook.
PresentationDigitalDocument: A slide or presentation file. Also called slideshow, slide deck, presentation.
WebContent: Web-addressable content of a page, site, or element. Also called web content.
HealthTopicContent: Web content about an aspect of a health topic. Also called health information, health content.
MedicalWebPage: A web page providing medical information. Also called medical page, health page.
WebPage: A single page on the web. Also called page, webpage.
AboutPage: A web page describing a person or organisation. Also called about page.
ContactPage: A web page with contact information. Also called contact page.
CheckoutPage: A web page for completing a purchase. Also called checkout, checkout page.
CollectionPage: A web page presenting a collection of items. Also called collection page, listing page.
ItemPage: A web page devoted to a single item. Also called item page, product page.
ProfilePage: A web page presenting a person's or entity's profile. Also called profile page.
QAPage: A web page focused on a question and its answers. Also called Q&A page.
FAQPage: A web page presenting frequently asked questions. Also called FAQ, FAQ page.
SearchResultsPage: A web page showing search results. Also called results page, SERP.
RealEstateListing: A listing describing property offers to lease or sell. Also called property listing.
ImageGallery: A web page presenting a gallery of images. Also called photo gallery, image gallery.
VideoGallery: A web page presenting a gallery of videos. Also called video gallery.
MediaGallery: A web page presenting mixed media. Also called media gallery.
WebSite: A set of related web pages served from one domain. Also called site, website.
WebPageElement: A component of a web page, such as a table or image. Also called page element, page section.
SiteNavigationElement: A navigation component of a page. Also called nav menu, navigation.
Table: A table of data on a web page. Also called data table, grid.
WPHeader: The header section of a web page. Also called page header.
WPFooter: The footer section of a web page. Also called page footer.
WPSideBar: A sidebar section of a web page. Also called sidebar.
WPAdBlock: An advertising section of a web page. Also called ad block, ad unit.
AmpStory: A visual storytelling format for mobile viewing. Also called web story, AMP story.
ArchiveComponent: Archive content with properties describing archival items and collections. Also called archival record, archive item.
CategoryCodeSet: A set of category code values. Also called code set, classification scheme.
DefinedTermSet: A set of defined terms such as a glossary or taxonomy. Also called glossary, dictionary, vocabulary.
MathSolver: A tool that solves mathematical problems. Also called math solver, equation solver.
HyperToc: A hypertext table of contents for complex media. Also called media table of contents, chapter list.
HyperTocEntry: An entry within a hypertext table of contents. Also called TOC entry, chapter marker.
